method: All bundled official line geometries; each original segment divided into equal parts no longer than 20 m, using midpoint nearest-distance to accepted non-shared graph geometries within 50 m. Flat Taiwan metre approximation (latitude x 111195, longitude x 100700). Length-weighted proportions, not administrative city coverage or route reachability.
limits: No network connectivity, sidewalk-side matching, road-crossing, barriers, entrances, elevation, source age, or on-site accessibility verification. Proximity is diagnostic only; never use as route authorization. Results depend on source order and bundled geographic scope.
